description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1805/31 of 10th April 2013 and others
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, including modifications to land parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names, and encumbrances. It contains detailed land registration information for specific parcels in various districts, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) as it focuses on land and property-related administrative matters rather than government structure, personnel, or other specialized categories.
